title: cotoneaster nummularius orbicularis
intro: Cotoneaster nummularius orbicularis, commonly known as the silver berry or silver cotoneaster, is a type of flowering plant in the rose family (Rosaceae). It is a deciduous shrub that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Cotoneaster nummularius orbicularis include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. These bioactive compounds may also contribute to its potential health benefits, including its ability to protect against oxidative stress and promote wound healing.
